name: 1000-lb Sisters
description: The Slaton sisters averaging over a thousand pounds, have always depended on each other for support. Now in their 30s, Amy wants to have children, but cannot due to her weight, while her elder sister Tammy is near bedridden.

videos.title: Meet The Slaton Sisters
videos.overview: The Slaton's are larger-than-life sisters who have always relied on each other and food for support. Amy, age 31, is desperate to have children, but hasn't been able to due to her weight. While Tammy, age 32, is one step away from being bedridden.

videos.title: 1000 lbs To Freedom
videos.overview: Amy and Tammy go to Atlanta to meet Dr. Procter to discuss weight loss surgery. When they arrive, Dr. Procter gives Tammy a hefty weight loss goal before he will approve her for surgery, meanwhile the dietician has more bad news for Amy.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Amy and Tammy eagerly begin their weight loss journey. Sticking to their diets is a matter of life and death but proves to be a real struggle. The pressure to reach their goals culminates in a huge fight that threatens their diets and relationship.

videos.title: A House Divided
videos.overview: After a stressful first month of dieting, the sisters head back to Atlanta for their one-month check in with Dr. Procter to find out if they are on the right path to their weight goals. The results force Amy to make a difficult decision.

videos.title: Wedding and Weigh-ins
videos.overview: Amy decides to have a real wedding ceremony because if she gets approved for surgery, she's afraid she may not survive; after the wedding, the sisters head to Atlanta hoping for a life-changing final weigh-in.

videos.title: Under the Knife
videos.overview: Amy undergoes gastric bypass surgery to change her life, but endangers herself by not sticking to the post-op diet. Tammy seeks support from her love interest, Jerry. Two months later, the sisters reveal the changes they've made.

videos.title: Life-Altering News
videos.overview: While Amy reaps the benefits of weight-loss surgery, her sister Tammy worries that she gained weight during quarantine; a visit to urgent care gives Amy life-changing news; Tammy's family confronts her over her health

videos.title: Tippin' the Scales
videos.overview: Tammy struggles to get back on the weight-loss wagon in order get approved for surgery, but this time, her brother, Chris, joins her on the journey. Amy must deal with one very big life-altering repercussion of having had her surgery

videos.title: Wake-Up Call
videos.overview: Tammy and Amy blame each other for their issues in therapy; when Tammy gets devastating news from Dr. Procter, her brother, Chris, makes a life-altering decision; a very pregnant Amy can't stop overeating, and the results are disastrous.

videos.title: A Fork in the Road
videos.overview: The Slatons are shocked by the cause of Amy's trip to the emergency room. Chris and Tammy see a new doctor, where Tammy must step on the scale again after a month of not sticking to her diet.

videos.title: Dropping Bombs
videos.overview: Tammy's new doctor gives her what feels like an insurmountable weight goal, but it's not the only challenge she's facing. Amy and Michael drop a bomb that changes everything.

videos.title: There's Something About Jerry
videos.overview: Tammy's boyfriend, Jerry, comes to visit just in time to celebrate the sisters' favourite holiday: Halloween. Tammy's sister Misty questions Jerry's intentions. Amy has to face another weigh-in after her concerning appointment with Dr. Procter.

videos.title: Jerry Bites Back
videos.overview: Amy counts down the days until her delivery with an eccentric photo shoot, while the family worries that Jerry is derailing Tammy's diet. Tammy reveals her big secret to Jerry.

videos.title: Everybody Hurts
videos.overview: When Tammy and Amy go see a psychic, they both get disturbing news. The family rallies together, and they are willing to try anything to help Tammy lose weight. Amy must face her worst fears when she's rushed to the ER.

videos.title: Labor of Love
videos.overview: Amy gets unsettling news about the birth of her baby as her high-risk pregnancy has last-minute complications; with their next weigh-in ahead of them, Chris and Tammy are cautiously optimistic until Tammy steps on the scale.

videos.title: Welcome to Rehab
videos.overview: With her weight spiraling, Tammy makes a life-altering decision.

videos.title: Goodbye Freedom
videos.overview: Tammy is back from rehab, and Amy makes a decision regarding her sister.

videos.title: Tammy's New Squeeze
videos.overview: Amy is upset that Tammy's new nurse isn't pushing her enough; Tammy has started slacking, and the family worries about what could be the cause; Chris and Tammy clash when he confronts her about the new man in her life.

videos.title: Heavy Hoarders
videos.overview: Amy must confront demons from her past, and Tammy admits to cheat days.

videos.title: Pushed Too Far
videos.overview: Chris comes down on Amy for enabling Tammy.

videos.title: Man vs Scale
videos.overview: Tammy must see a new therapist, but things don't go the way she'd hoped; Amy wants to lose her excess skin, but she gets bad news at the plastic surgeon's office; Chris faces the scale; if he's below 400 pounds, his surgery is on.

videos.title: The Moment Of Truth
videos.overview: Chris faces the ultimate weigh-in to get approved for bariatric surgery. With Tammy's weight at a standstill, Amy and Michael make a life-altering decision. The family's fears about Tammy's choice in partners are realized.

videos.title: A Very Slaton Vacation
videos.overview: While Chris makes progress after his surgery, Tammy gets discouraging news. Amy plans a unique bash for Tammy's 35th birthday. The family excitedly plans their first vacation together with all five siblings, but concerns rise about Tammy's mobility.

videos.title: Smoky Mountain Meltdown
videos.overview: The family vacation starts off terribly when Tammy refuses to enter the cabin. Chris hopes he's lost enough weight to fulfill a life-long dream. A last attempt to save the vacation ends in another confrontation. The siblings discover Tammy's secret.

videos.title: Moving On Up And Partying On Down
videos.overview: After a rift on the family vacation, Amy returns home and drops a bomb on Tammy. While Amy focuses on her new life, Tammy makes a decision that takes her even further away from her weight-loss goals.

videos.title: End Of An Era
videos.overview: Amy and Michael finally move out of the duplex, while Tammy's partying phase takes a turn for the worse. Amanda tries to get through to her sister before it's too late, and Amy's in for a rude awakening at her annual check up with Dr. Procter.

videos.title: Never Say Never
videos.overview: Amy sees a paediatric dietitian and faces some difficult truths about Gage's diet. Dr. Smith makes a house call and confronts Tammy about her partying lifestyle. While on the road with Chris, Tammy's health hits a dangerous low point.

videos.title: The Sweet and Sour Life
videos.overview: Having survived yet another brush with death, Tammy recovers at rehab, but a new scare threatens her life; the family adjusts to life without Tammy; Amy's big surprise stuns everyone.

videos.title: Can't Have Your Cake and Eat It Too
videos.overview: Tammy's seemingly good progress inspires Amy to visit, reuniting the siblings for the first time in months; Amanda begins a new chapter in her life; Amy learns she's at risk of serious complications if she doesn't get her eating under control.

videos.title: I Don't Want to Taco Bout It
videos.overview: Tammy hits a tipping point at rehab, and more bad news from back home sends her into a downward spiral; Chris gets a reality check during a check in with Dr. Smith; the family says goodbye to a beloved family member.

videos.title: Icing on the Cake
videos.overview: After finding out Tammy's been robbed, Misty and Amanda visit to break the news in person; while Chris pushes ahead toward his surgery goal, Amy has a setback and is rushed to the ER; with her sisters by her side, Tammy faces the results of her weigh in.

videos.title: Greatest Thing Since Sliced Bread
videos.overview: Tammy struggles to cope after surviving a near-death experience; Amy realizes being an overweight mom may prove to be too much; Chris is desperate to get rid of excess skin; Amanda offloads some dead weight of her own.

videos.title: A Lot of Cooks in the Kitchen
videos.overview: Amy feels from giving birth and finding out Michael has COVID-19; after 20 years, Chris gets back on the horse; Tammy is almost at the finish line for surgery approval, but worries she won't pass her final assessments.

videos.title: Proof Is in the Pudding
videos.overview: After years of struggling, Tammy finally has her weight loss surgery, but things are not as straightforward as expected.

videos.title: Forbidden Fruit
videos.overview: Tammy wants to come home, but a setback causes a major blowup between her and the family.

videos.title: Walkin' on Eggshells
videos.overview: Tammy announces her engagement to the family and reveals that her big day is only two weeks away; Amy takes up maid of honor duties; the family wonders if there's another reason Tammy is rushing down the aisle.

videos.title: Bringing Home the Bacon
videos.overview: As Tammy heads home after 14 months in rehab, she's forced to make the most difficult decision of her life. Fed up with not having help, Amy feels her marriage is starting to unravel. Amanda and Misty reveal they're getting bariatric surgery.

videos.title: Fork You! I'm Done!
videos.overview: Tammy hosts a housewarming party and has a few choice words for her mom; Amy's world is turned upside down when she finally confronts Michael over his lack of help with raising their two boys; meanwhile, Caleb hasn't been honest with Tammy.

videos.title: Well-Done and Over With
videos.overview: After the blowout with Michael, Amy makes the hardest decision of her life; Chris and Tammy have a long-overdue appointment with Dr. Smith; worried about surgery, Amanda and Misty do a last-minute cleanse to sweat out nicotine.

videos.title: The Grapes of Wrath
videos.overview: Amanda and Misty get big news and take a major step in their health journey; Amy and Tammy blow off some steam; Amy gets some devastating news from her lawyer that sends her reeling.

videos.title: The Custard-y Battle
videos.overview: Amy faces Michael in court at their first divorce hearing. Chris finds an unusual way to get healthy food. Tammy explores the possibility of having kids. Later, Tammy heads to rehab for a recon mission after learning some information about Caleb.

videos.title: Fried, Cried and Tried
videos.overview: Caleb surprises Tammy with a romantic dinner date, but it goes south when Tammy learns what's on the menu. The Slatons attend a Zumba class together, but Amy's lack of self-care leads to a meltdown that has the whole family feeling déjà vu.

videos.title: Dill With It
videos.overview: The family preps for their very first beach vacation, and Tammy hits some major milestones. While everyone flies, Amy opts for a nine-hour car ride which leaves her and the boys cranky. Then, Chris gives Amy some tough love.

videos.title: Boiling Point
videos.overview: Amanda reels after leaving dinner; Chris crosses something off his bucket list; Tammy tries to have fun but misses Caleb; fed up with her siblings critiquing her, Amy reaches her boiling point and explodes.

videos.title: Sunflower
videos.overview: Amy is ashamed of her behavior in Florida and wants to make amends, but she worries Amanda won't accept her apology; when Tammy gets some devastating news, her whole world is turned upside down, and her family rallies behind her in support.

videos.title: Life is Going to Be Gouda
videos.overview: Tammy takes small steps towards independence, Amy moves home but struggles with ghosts of the past, the sisters get new looks to go with their new attitude, and an upcoming Dr. Smith appointment has everyone on edge.

videos.title: Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: For the first time ever, Dr. Smith holds an all-sibling weigh-in appointment,and the moment of truth is a tough pill to swallow for some.

videos.title: War and Peas
videos.overview: Tammy needs a new place to live but finds more problems than solutions and Amy makes a peace offering with some highly questionable ingredients.

videos.title: I Candy-cane't
videos.overview: A time for cheer is met with jeer as the entire family remains divided during Christmas.

videos.title: Carbe Diem
videos.overview: Chris gears up for his upcoming appointment with a plastic surgeon and encourages Tammy to tag along.

videos.title: Limo Beans
videos.overview: Tammy has her heart set on skin removal but is met with a roadblock.

videos.title: Turning a New Beef
videos.overview: Tammy and Amy beef over their big night out.

videos.title: Peas Out, Yo!
videos.overview: Everyone prepares for London amid another flare up between Tammy and Amanda while Chris and Tammy visit Dr. Turner hoping to get approved for skin removal surgery.

videos.title: Bangers and Clash
videos.overview: The family arrives in London for their first international vacation and learns even more surprising news about their ancestry.

videos.title: Nothing is Impastable
videos.overview: The family deals with the aftermath of Amy's meltdown. Back home, Chris gets skin removal surgery. Amy has a risqué photoshoot. Tammy finds doctors who can do her skin removal surgery but some test results force Tammy to confess a long-held secret.

videos.title: Clapback
videos.overview: Tammy, Amy and their siblings sit down to watch their most memorable clips.

videos.title: Thinking with Her Vajayjay
videos.overview: Tammy's skin removal surgery is still up in the air as she struggles to kick bad habits. Amy's got a new roommate and a new man. Chris' plays referee between Brittany and their new neighbor. Tammy is keeping a secret from her family.

videos.title: Smitten Like a New York Kitten
videos.overview: Tammy gets a push to reveal her personal life to her family. Amy's life gets even more chaotic, pushing her to make a rash decision. Chris and his wife make a big decision about her health.

videos.title: Chewy Ca(ra)mel
videos.overview: Tammy reveals to her sisters that she's dating a woman and their reaction surprises her. Chris and Tammy check-in on their skin removal progress, and a harrowing moment at the petting zoo sees Amy's life turned upside down.

videos.title: The Big Camel in the Room
videos.overview: Amy reels emotionally and physically from her camel bite and arrest. Chris explores a passion project, and Tammy expands her circle and fulfills a childhood dream.

videos.title: Keep the Eye on the Tiger
videos.overview: Tammy takes a big step forward in her relationship with Andrea.

videos.title: She's Got This Mantality
videos.overview: When the siblings react to Amy's proposal, relationships are fractured.

videos.title: I'm Going to Police-Fully Duck Out
videos.overview: Tammy addresses Amy about her weight gain and the family heads to Pittsburgh for Tammy's skin removal surgery.

videos.title: Her Turkey Gobler's Gone
videos.overview: A missing tool in the operating room causes delays to Tammy's extreme skin removal and Amy decides she's had enough and makes a bold move.

videos.title: We Be Trippin'
videos.overview: The family takes a trip down memory lane and revisits the important people and places who have made them who they are today, but not without jokes and hilarity along the way.

videos.title: Abysmal to the Wedding
videos.overview: Amy and Tammy have drifted further than ever, but unbeknownst to them, are living parallel lives as each of their romantic partnerships takes big steps.

videos.title: Not Tonight, Satan
videos.overview: After her life-altering skin removal surgery, Tammy is ready to find her calling and starts her first day as an animal shelter volunteer.

videos.title: Tinture Tantrums
videos.overview: Amy and Brian go ghost hunting and Chris hosts a BBQ to celebrate Brittany's weight loss, but it's quickly overshadowed by Amy's maid of honor reveal.

videos.title: Nobody's Butt Monkey
videos.overview: Amy moves ahead with securing wedding details, sans Tammy and Chris and Misty worry about Amy's health.

videos.title: Idle Hands Are a Devil’s B****
videos.overview: After peace talks between Tammy and Amy go south, the sisters are more divided than ever.

videos.title: Reconciling Indifferences
videos.overview: Amy pursues her dream of being an artist while Chris hopes a vacation will unite the family.

videos.title: Bride-Diva
videos.overview: Amy gets some unexpected news from the eye doctor while the family heads to New Orleans and Amy is left speechless when they spring a surprise on her.

videos.title: Something Borrowed, Someone's Blue
videos.overview: The family finishes out their New Orleans vacation with a surprise bachelorette party for Amy.

videos.title: Crying Tears of Blood
videos.overview: Amy undergoes the knife less than 2 weeks before her wedding. Tammy's back on the fence when it comes to attending Amy's wedding.

videos.title: Getting Mercinal Right Now
videos.overview: The family gathers to see Amy get married, but a surprising confrontation could derail the biggest day of Amy's life.
